# Shreyansh Singh

Official website: https://shreyanshsingh.in/

## The Store at the Edge of Everything
Canonical book page: https://shreyanshsingh.in/the-store-at-the-edge-of-everything/

The Store at the Edge of Everything is an illustrated atmospheric horror mystery by Shreyansh Singh. Season One is subtitled "The Blood Remembers." It is set on fictional Ashmore Island in the Norwegian Sea. Investigator and writer Aana Voss investigates a pattern of disappearances connected to Halverson's Departmental Store after her younger brother Nils vanishes.

Author: Shreyansh Singh.
ISBN-13: 9798177645483.
First edition: 2026.
Core genres: atmospheric horror, mystery thriller, psychological suspense, biological horror.
Ashmore Island is fictional.
